nom: PLANTIFIQUE Kojic Acid & Turmeric Cleansing Pads for Dark Spots

avis.texte: Ive had a random dark spot that looked like a constant smudge of dirt on my cheek for years now. I used these for one day, ONE DAY and its already noticeably faded where you dont notice it at all and it doesn't pick up in a picture when I take one. Im genuinely shocked.
I didn’t see much of a change in the dark spots on my face. Probably would not buy again.

Really love these cleansing pads. I had a different brand before, but these from Plantifique really suds up, and one pad can be used for face, arms, hands and more. I'm starting to notice that some of the dullness is going away, and my face just looks a whole lot clearer overall.

avis.titre: Good results so far, pleasant to use.
avis.texte: Does a good job of reducing my daughter's melasma when used with retinol cream and sunscreen every day. Second time purchasing. On a scale of 1-10, the spots have gone from 10 to 5 in a couple of months, and are still diminishing.

These are really cleansing ! Your skin feels really really clean after use. I also love that you get 100 pads in each so you know you get 100 washes on your face ! It comes with a little tweezer to take each pad out which is simple. The only reason I didn’t give it five stars is because I wish it had just a tad more exfoliation on one side of the pad but they are near perfect. My skin is brighter and cleaner !

avis.titre: Really like these facial cleaning pads
avis.texte: Great product to add to my nightly or morning routine, I love that it gets a little foamy when using on a damp face. I've gotten compliments on my skin too! Would buy again!

I really like these cleansing pads. They are easy to use and leave my skin feeling clean, smooth and refreshed without being too harsh. I like that they contain kojic acid, turmeric, niacinamide, vitamin C and ceramides. With regular use, my skin looks brighter and more even. The pads are also convenient and easy to use. Overall, a good addition to my skincare routine.

I use these twice a day as part of my routine and they dont dry out my face at all, i love the little glow they give my skin and they fact they dont make my acne break out and flare up. I am middle aged with hormonal acne that comes and goes like my children attitude and these just work for me, help clear it up faster then anything else i have used and i have been on perscribed acne creams and none of them helped at all. Cant fault these, love the packaging but not a fan of the tiny tongs.
Ich bin überrascht, wie gut sich diese pads anfühlen. Die Haut fühlt sich gereinigt und samtweich an. Daa Produkte erfüllt meine Erwartungen.
